blockerRegister.reason: The approved development request still requires a dated human product-owner decision for the initial user segment, first platform, bounded MVP, differentiation, exclusions, and meaning of all devices.
Discovery evidence and its research-integrity checks are not present in this repository coordination baseline.
Architecture, open-source governance, security, signing, update, and release-ownership decisions require accountable approval and independent evidence.
Only WS-15 may issue the independent engineering disposition after all preceding workstreams provide evidence.

acceptanceTraceability.area: human product decision and bounded brief

implementationNotes: No application implementation is authorized by this coordination workstream.
Downstream implementations must place download business rules in one shared domain or service implementation consumed by UI and adapters.
User-visible behavior requires real DOM, browser, integration, or equivalent runtime evidence; source-pattern checks are insufficient.
Local, test, and staging are the only declared environments. Production actions require separate attributed human approval.
No database migration, infrastructure mutation, deployment, credential use, or Git-history operation was performed by WS-01.
knownRisks: The request spans three native desktop platforms before a first platform and supported OS versions are approved.
The repository currently contains coordination scaffolding but no application implementation or automated product tests.
Download integrity, restart recovery, filesystem conflicts, servers without range support, and resource limits remain high-risk technical areas.
Browser integration, authentication, update signing, telemetry defaults, dependency policy, and binary release ownership remain unresolved.
Accessibility and usability outcomes cannot be claimed until representative runtime testing occurs on approved platforms.
